standouts.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
standouts.text: It closed back above its 50-day average: above it on 1 of the last 3 closes.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram rising.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: Momentum stuck in a bear range
against.text: RSI has failed below 55 on every bounce for three months and fell to 16: the range momentum holds in a downtrend.
against.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

against.head: Sellers control the volume
against.text: Over ten weeks, an up day traded 0.7x the volume of a down day.
against.learn: Volume on up days against volume on down days; above 1 means buyers trade more.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 47% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Oct 26) against a lower low in momentum (6 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend
material.text: Price has dipped toward its 50-day average but holds above the rising 200-day, with the 50-day above the 200-day.
material.learn: A dip inside an uptrend; buyers often return at support.

material.head: Support −0.3% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −0.3% below (0.4 ATR), where 5 levels (3 kinds) meet: the average price paid since the Oct 28 low, the 50-day average and the 38.2% retracement of the Oct 28–Nov 24 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
